name: Cryptsy
rootCause: Cryptsy reported a July 29, 2014 wallet compromise tied to a Lucky7Coin IRC backdoor that let a trusted wallet process run unauthorized commands on exchange infrastructure. Public records support the backdoor mechanism and a later class recovery, but the on-chain theft path and exact unreconciled loss total remain incomplete. Cryptsy trusted third-party Lucky7Coin wallet code that contained an IRC command path capable of arbitrary host commands. That turned a maintenance channel into an unauthorized control plane over wallet infrastructure. The record does not establish exposure of Cryptsy private keys.
